decisions.label: Chain length (m)
decisions.note: Every leashed creature's chain; at full length she drags it (Ed, 2026-11-03: "about the size of a fight (80m?)"). 0: no chains.

decisions.label: Youth drag
decisions.note: The share of her motion away a taut youth's chain takes (Ed, 2026-11-03: "Dragging youths slows you down a bit (e.g. 30%). Dragging adults slows you down a lot (e.g. 70%). Dragging legends slows you down completely (100%)").

decisions.label: Adult drag
decisions.note: The share of her motion away a taut adult's chain takes (Ed, 2026-11-03: "Dragging youths slows you down a bit (e.g. 30%). Dragging adults slows you down a lot (e.g. 70%). Dragging legends slows you down completely (100%)").

decisions.label: Legend drag
decisions.note: The share of her motion away a taut legend's chain takes (1: she can't go further) (Ed, 2026-11-03: "Dragging youths slows you down a bit (e.g. 30%). Dragging adults slows you down a lot (e.g. 70%). Dragging legends slows you down completely (100%)").
